55: 					string(quotaCode), serviceCode, serviceQuotaStatus.Value),
56: 			)
57: 			serviceQuotaStatus.Status = awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestCompleted
58: 			return nil
59: 		case awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestInProgress:
60: 			reqLogger.Info(
61: 				fmt.Sprintf("Quota Increase IN_PROGRESS for QuotaCode [%s] ServiceCode [%s] Requested Value [%d]",
62: 					string(quotaCode), serviceCode, serviceQuotaStatus.Value),
63: 			)
64: 			return nil

68: 					string(quotaCode), serviceCode, serviceQuotaStatus.Value),
69: 			)
70: 			serviceQuotaStatus.Status = awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestDenied
71: 			return nil
72: 		case awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestTodo:
73: 			submitted, err := setServiceQuota(reqLogger, awsClient, string(quotaCode), serviceCode, float64(serviceQuotaStatus.Value))
74: 			if err != nil {

76: 			}

135: func serviceQuotaNeedsIncrease(reqLogger logr.Logger, client awsclient.Client, quotaCode string, serviceCode string, desiredQuota float64) (bool, error) {
136: 	var result *servicequotas.GetServiceQuotaOutput
137: 
138: 	// Default is 1/10 of a second, but any retries we need to make should be delayed a few seconds
139: 	// This also defaults to an exponential backoff, so we only need to try ~5 times, default is 10
140: 	retry.DefaultDelay = 3 * time.Second
141: 	retry.DefaultAttempts = uint(5)
142: 	err := retry.Do(
143: 		func() (err error) {
144: 			// Get the current existing quota setting
145: 			result, err = client.GetServiceQuota(
146: 				&servicequotas.GetServiceQuotaInput{
147: 					QuotaCode:   aws.String(quotaCode),
148: 					ServiceCode: aws.String(serviceCode),
149: 				},
150: 			)
151: 			return err
152: 		},
153: 
154: 		// Retry if we receive some specific errors: access denied, rate limit or server-side error
155: 		retry.RetryIf(func(err error) bool {
156: 			if aerr, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
157: 				switch aerr.Code() {
158: 				// AccessDenied may indicate the BYOCAdminAccess role has not yet propagated
159: 				case "AccessDeniedException":
160: 					return true
161: 				case "ServiceException":
162: 					return true
163: 				case "TooManyRequestsException":
164: 					return true
165: 				// Can be caused by the client token not yet propagated
166: 				case "UnrecognizedClientException":
167: 					return true
168: 				}
169: 			}
170: 			// Otherwise, do not retry
171: 			return false
172: 		}),
173: 	)
174: 
175: 	// Regardless of errors, if we got the result for the actual quota,
176: 	// then compare it to the desired quota.
177: 	if result.Quota != nil {
178: 		if *result.Quota.Value < desiredQuota {
179: 			reqLogger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Requiring a servicequota increase: current [%.1f] wanted [%.1f]\n", *result.Quota.Value, desiredQuota))
180: 			return true, err
181: 		}
182: 	}
183: 
184: 	// Otherwise return false (doesn't need increase) and any errors
185: 	return false, err
186: }

267: func checkQuotaRequestStatus(reqLogger logr.Logger, awsClient awsclient.Client, quotaCode string, serviceCode string, expectedQuota float64) (awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestStatus, error) {
268: 
269: 	var nextToken *string
270: 	// Default is 1/10 of a second, but any retries we need to make should be delayed a few seconds
271: 	// This also defaults to an exponential backoff, so we only need to try ~5 times, default is 10
272: 	retry.DefaultDelay = 3 * time.Second
273: 	retry.DefaultAttempts = uint(5)
274: 
275: 	for {
276: 		// This returns with pagination, so we have to iterate over the pagination data
277: 
278: 		var result *servicequotas.ListRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistoryByQuotaOutput
279: 
280: 		err := retry.Do(
281: 			func() (err error) {
282: 				// Get a (possibly paginated) list of quota change requests by quota
283: 				result, err = awsClient.ListRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistoryByQuota(
284: 					&servicequotas.ListRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistoryByQuotaInput{
285: 						NextToken:   nextToken,
286: 						ServiceCode: aws.String(serviceCode),
287: 						QuotaCode:   aws.String(quotaCode),
288: 					},
289: 				)
290: 				return err
291: 			},
292: 
293: 			// Retry if we receive some specific errors: access denied, rate limit or server-side error
294: 			retry.RetryIf(func(err error) bool {
295: 				if aerr, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
296: 					switch aerr.Code() {
297: 					// AccessDenied may indicate the BYOCAdminAccess role has not yet propagated
298: 					case "AccessDeniedException":
299: 						return true
300: 					case "ServiceException":
301: 						return true
302: 					case "TooManyRequestsException":
303: 						return true
304: 					// Can be caused by the client token not yet propagated
305: 					case "UnrecognizedClientException":
306: 						return true
307: 					}
308: 				}
309: 				// Otherwise, do not retry
310: 				return false
311: 			}),
312: 		)
313: 
314: 		if err != nil {
315: 			// Return an error if retrieving the change history fails
316: 			return awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestTodo, err
317: 		}
318: 
319: 		// Check all the returned requests to see if one matches the quota increase we'd request
320: 		// If so, it's already been submitted
321: 		for _, change := range result.RequestedQuotas {
322: 			if changeRequestMatches(change, quotaCode, serviceCode, expectedQuota) {
323: 				switch *change.Status {
324: 				case "PENDING", "CASE_OPENED":
325: 					return awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestInProgress, nil
326: 				case "APPROVED", "CASE_CLOSED":
327: 					return awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestCompleted, nil
328: 				case "DENIED":
329: 					return awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestDenied, nil
330: 				}
331: 			}
332: 		}
333: 
334: 		// Set NextToken to retrieve the next page and loop again
335: 		nextToken = result.NextToken
336: 		if nextToken == nil {
337: 			return awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestTodo, nil
338: 		}
339: 	}
340: }

359: func GetServiceQuotaRequest(reqLogger logr.Logger, awsClientBuilder awsclient.IBuilder, awsSetupClient awsclient.Client, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account, client client.Client) (reconcile.Result, error) {
360: 	// First we get all request we need to get a status update on:
361: 	// - Requests that are not yet open on the AWS side
362: 	// - Requests that are open but not yet completed
363: 	currentInFlightCount, inFlightQuotaRequests := currentAcctInstance.GetQuotaRequestsByStatus(awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestInProgress)
364: 	_, onlyOpenRequests := currentAcctInstance.GetQuotaRequestsByStatus(awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestTodo)
365: 	if currentInFlightCount <= MaxOpenQuotaRequests {
366: 		reqLogger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("currentInFlightCount (%d) <= maxOpenQuotaRequests (%d)", currentInFlightCount, MaxOpenQuotaRequests))
367: 		var maxRequestsReached = false
368: 		for region, onlyOpenRequest := range onlyOpenRequests {
369: 			if maxRequestsReached {
370: 				break
371: 			}
372: 			if _, ok := inFlightQuotaRequests[region]; !ok {
373: 				inFlightQuotaRequests[region] = awsv1alpha1.AccountServiceQuota{}
374: 			}
375: 			for quotaCode, req := range onlyOpenRequest {
376: 				inFlightQuotaRequests[region][quotaCode] = req
377: 				currentInFlightCount += 1
378: 				if currentInFlightCount >= MaxOpenQuotaRequests {
379: 					maxRequestsReached = true
380: 					break
381: 				}
382: 			}
383: 		}
384: 	}
385: 	reqLogger.Info("Handling quotarequets", "current-in-flight-count", currentInFlightCount)
386: 	err := UpdateServiceQuotaRequests(reqLogger, awsClientBuilder, awsSetupClient, currentAcctInstance, client, inFlightQuotaRequests, currentInFlightCount)
387: 	if err != nil {
388: 		return reconcile.Result{}, err
389: 	}
390: 	err = client.Status().Update(context.TODO(), currentAcctInstance)
391: 	if err != nil {
392: 		return reconcile.Result{}, err
393: 	}
394: 	return reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: 30 * time.Second, Requeue: true}, err
395: }

397: func UpdateServiceQuotaRequests(reqLogger logr.Logger, awsClientBuilder awsclient.IBuilder, awsSetupClient awsclient.Client, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account, client client.Client, serviceQuotaRequests awsv1alpha1.RegionalServiceQuotas, count int) error {
398: 	for region, quotaRequest := range serviceQuotaRequests {
399: 		regionLogger := reqLogger.WithValues("Region", region)
400: 		roleToAssume := currentAcctInstance.GetAssumeRole()
401: 		awsAssumedRoleClient, _, err := AssumeRoleAndCreateClient(reqLogger, awsClientBuilder, currentAcctInstance, client, awsSetupClient, region, roleToAssume, "")
402: 		if err != nil {
403: 			reqLogger.Error(err, "Could not impersonate AWS account", "aws-account", currentAcctInstance.Spec.AwsAccountID)
404: 			return err
405: 		}
406: 
407: 		// for each open quota in this region check to see if we need to request an increase.
408: 		for quotaCode, openQuotaRef := range quotaRequest {
409: 			reqLogger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Handling quota request for quotaCode: %s", quotaCode))
410: 			err = HandleServiceQuotaRequests(regionLogger, awsAssumedRoleClient, quotaCode, openQuotaRef)
411: 			if err != nil {
412: 				return err // TODO: For review, do we want to be handling the error like this?
413: 			}
414: 		}
415: 	}
416: 
417: 	deniedCount, _ := currentAcctInstance.GetQuotaRequestsByStatus(awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestDenied)
418: 
419: 	if deniedCount > 0 {
420: 		controllerutils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, "ServiceQuota increase got denied", awsv1alpha1.AccountFailed, AccountFailed)

207: 				return nil

284: func (r *AccountValidationReconciler) ValidateAccountOU(awsClient awsclient.Client, account awsv1alpha1.Account, poolOU string, baseOU string) error {
285: 	// Default OU should be the aao-managed-accounts OU.
286: 	correctOU := poolOU
287: 
288: 	ouNeedsCreating := false
289: 
290: 	// If the legal entity is not empty, it should go into the legalEntity's OU
291: 	if account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID != "" {
292: 		claimedOU, err := r.GetOUIDFromName(awsClient, baseOU, account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID)
293: 		if err != nil {
294: 			if errors.Is(err, awsv1alpha1.ErrNonexistentOU) {
295: 				log.Info("OU doesn't exist. Will need to create it.", "OU Name", account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID)
296: 				ouNeedsCreating = true
297: 			} else {
298: 				log.Info("Unexpected error attempting to get OU ID for Legal Entity", "legal_entity", account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID)
299: 				return &AccountValidationError{
300: 					Type: OULookupFailed,
301: 					Err:  errors.New("unexpected error attempting to get OU ID for legal entity"),
302: 				}
303: 			}
304: 		}
305: 
306: 		correctOU = claimedOU
307: 	}
308: 
309: 	if ouNeedsCreating {
310: 		if accountMoveEnabled {
311: 			createdOU, err := accountclaim.CreateOrFindOU(log, awsClient, account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID, baseOU)
312: 			if err != nil {
313: 				return err
314: 			}
315: 			correctOU = createdOU
316: 		} else {
317: 			log.Info("Would attempt to create the OU here, but AccountMoving is disabled.")
318: 		}
319: 	}
320: 
321: 	if correctOU == "" {
322: 		log.Info("Error attempting to get correct OU. Got empty string.")
323: 		return &AccountValidationError{
324: 			Type: OULookupFailed,
325: 			Err:  fmt.Errorf("Empty String when attempting to get correct OU"),
326: 		}
327: 	}

329: 	inCorrectOU := IsAccountInCorrectOU(account, awsClient, func(s string) bool {
330: 		return s == correctOU
331: 	})
332: 	if inCorrectOU {

334: 	} else {
335: 		log.Info("Account is not in the correct OU - it will be moved.")
336: 		err := MoveAccount(account.Spec.AwsAccountID, awsClient, correctOU, accountMoveEnabled)
337: 		if err != nil {

339: 			return &AccountValidationError{

341: 				Err:  err,
342: 			}
343: 		}

348: func (r *AccountValidationReconciler) GetOUIDFromName(client awsclient.Client, parentid string, ouName string) (string, error) {
349: 	// Check in-memory storage first
350: 	if ouID, ok := r.OUNameIDMap[ouName]; ok {
351: 		return ouID, nil
352: 	}
353: 
354: 	// Loop through all OUs in the parent until we find the ID of the OU with the given name
355: 	ouID := ""
356: 	listOrgUnitsForParentID := organizations.ListOrganizationalUnitsForParentInput{
357: 		ParentId: &parentid,
358: 	}
359: 	for ouID == "" {
360: 		// Get a list with a fraction of the OUs in this parent starting from NextToken
361: 		listOut, err := client.ListOrganizationalUnitsForParent(&listOrgUnitsForParentID)
362: 		if err != nil {
363: 			if aerr, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
364: 				unexpectedErrorMsg := fmt.Sprintf("FindOUFromParentID: Unexpected AWS Error when attempting to find OU ID from Parent: %s", aerr.Code())
365: 				log.Info(unexpectedErrorMsg)
366: 			}
367: 			return "", err
368: 		}
369: 		for _, element := range listOut.OrganizationalUnits {
370: 			if *element.Name == ouName {
371: 				// We've found the OU, so let's map this to the in-memory store
372: 				r.OUNameIDMap[ouName] = *element.Id
373: 				// and return it
374: 				return *element.Id, nil
375: 			}
376: 		}
377: 		// If the OU is not found we should update the input for the next list call
378: 		if listOut.NextToken != nil {
379: 			listOrgUnitsForParentID.NextToken = listOut.NextToken
380: 			continue
381: 		}
382: 		return "", awsv1alpha1.ErrNonexistentOU
383: 	}
384: 	return ouID, nil
385: }

387: func (r *AccountValidationReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, request ctrl.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {
388: 	log.WithValues("Controller", controllerName, "Request.Namespace", request.Namespace, "Request.Name", request.Name)
389: 	reqLogger := log.WithValues("Controller", controllerName, "Request.Namespace", request.Namespace, "Request.Name", request.Name)
390: 
391: 	// Setup: retrieve account and awsClient
392: 	var account awsv1alpha1.Account
393: 	err := r.Client.Get(context.TODO(), request.NamespacedName, &account)
394: 	if err != nil {
395: 		log.Info("Account does not exist", "account-request", request.NamespacedName, "error", err)
396: 		return utils.DoNotRequeue()
397: 	}
398: 	if account.DeletionTimestamp != nil {
399: 		log.Info("Account is being deleted - not running any validations", "account", account.Name)
400: 		return utils.DoNotRequeue()
401: 	}
402: 
403: 	cm, err := utils.GetOperatorConfigMap(r.Client)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		log.Error(err, "Could not retrieve the operator configmap")
406: 		return utils.RequeueAfter(5 * time.Minute)
407: 	}
408: 
409: 	enabled, err := strconv.ParseBool(cm.Data["feature.validation_move_account"])
410: 	if err != nil {
411: 		log.Info("Could not retrieve feature flag 'feature.validation_move_account' - account moving is disabled")
412: 	} else {
413: 		accountMoveEnabled = enabled
414: 	}
415: 	log.Info("Is moving accounts enabled?", "enabled", accountMoveEnabled)
416: 
417: 	enabled, err = strconv.ParseBool(cm.Data["feature.validation_tag_account"])
418: 	if err != nil {
419: 		log.Info("Could not retrieve feature flag 'feature.validation_tag_account' - account tagging is disabled")
420: 	} else {
421: 		accountTagEnabled = enabled
422: 	}
423: 	log.Info("Is tagging accounts enabled?", "enabled", accountTagEnabled)
424: 
425: 	enabled, err = strconv.ParseBool(cm.Data["feature.validation_delete_account"])
426: 	if err != nil {
427: 		log.Info("Could not retrieve feature flag 'feature.validation_delete_account' - account deletion is disabled")
428: 	} else {
429: 		accountDeletionEnabled = enabled
430: 	}
431: 	log.Info("Is account deletion enabled?", "enabled", accountDeletionEnabled)
432: 
433: 	awsClientInput := awsclient.NewAwsClientInput{
434: 		AwsRegion:  config.GetDefaultRegion(),
435: 		SecretName: utils.AwsSecretName,
436: 		NameSpace:  awsv1alpha1.AccountCrNamespace,
437: 	}
438: 	awsClient, err := r.awsClientBuilder.GetClient(controllerName, r.Client, awsClientInput)
439: 	if err != nil {
440: 		log.Error(err, "Could not retrieve AWS client.")
441: 	}
442: 
443: 	// Perform any checks we want
444: 	// Check if the account is a candidate for cleanup, i.e. it is failed and has no AWS account ID
445: 	err = ValidateRemoval(account)
446: 	if err == nil {
447: 		if accountDeletionEnabled {
448: 			err = r.Client.Delete(context.TODO(), &account)
449: 			if err != nil {
450: 				return utils.RequeueWithError(err)
451: 			}
452: 		} else {
453: 			log.Info("Account is a candidate for cleanup but account deletion is disabled (dry run)", "account", account.Name)
454: 		}
455: 	}
456: 
457: 	err = ValidateAccountOrigin(account)
458: 	if err != nil {
459: 		// Decide who we will requeue now
460: 		validationError, ok := err.(*AccountValidationError)
461: 		if ok && validationError.Type == InvalidAccount {
462: 			return utils.DoNotRequeue()
463: 		}
464: 		return utils.RequeueWithError(err)
465: 	}
466: 
467: 	err = ValidateAwsAccountId(account)
468: 	if err != nil {
469: 		validationError, ok := err.(*AccountValidationError)
470: 		if ok && validationError.Type == MissingAWSAccount {
471: 			return utils.DoNotRequeue()
472: 		}
473: 		return utils.RequeueWithError(err)
474: 	}
475: 
476: 	err = r.ValidateAccountOU(awsClient, account, cm.Data["root"], cm.Data["base"])
477: 	if err != nil {
478: 		// Decide who we will requeue now
479: 		validationError, ok := err.(*AccountValidationError)
480: 		if ok && validationError.Type == AccountMoveFailed {
481: 			return utils.RequeueAfter(moveWaitTime)
482: 		}
483: 		return utils.RequeueWithError(err)
484: 	}
485: 
486: 	shardName, ok := cm.Data["shard-name"]
487: 	if !ok {
488: 		log.Info("Could not retrieve configuration map value 'shard-name' - account tagging is disabled")
489: 	} else {
490: 		if shardName == "" {
491: 			log.Info("Cluster configuration is missing a shardName value.  Skipping validation for this tag.")
492: 		} else {
493: 			err = ValidateAccountTags(awsClient, aws.String(account.Spec.AwsAccountID), shardName, accountTagEnabled)
494: 			if err != nil {
495: 				validationError, ok := err.(*AccountValidationError)
496: 				if ok && (validationError.Type == MissingTag || validationError.Type == IncorrectOwnerTag) {
497: 					log.Error(validationError, validationError.Err.Error())
498: 				}
499: 				return utils.RequeueWithError(err)
500: 			}
501: 		}
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	// check if account belongs to accountpool
505: 	if !account.IsBYOC() {
506: 		err = r.ValidateRegionalServiceQuotas(reqLogger, &account, r.awsClientBuilder)
507: 		if err != nil {
508: 			validationError, ok := err.(*AccountValidationError)
509: 			if ok && validationError.Type == NotAllServicequotasApplied {
510: 				return reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: 10 * time.Minute}, nil
511: 			}
512: 			return utils.RequeueWithError(err)
513: 		}
514: 
515: 	}
516: 	return utils.DoNotRequeue()
517: }

203: 		return r.handleAccountInitializingRegions(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance)
204: 	}
205: 
206: 	// If the account is BYOC, needs some different set up
207: 	if newBYOCAccount(currentAcctInstance) {
208: 		var result reconcile.Result
209: 		var initErr error
210: 
211: 		result, initErr = r.initializeNewCCSAccount(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance)
212: 		if initErr != nil {
213: 			// TODO: If we have recoverable results from above, how do we allow them to requeue if state is failed
214: 			_, stateErr := r.setAccountFailed(
215: 				reqLogger,
216: 				currentAcctInstance,
217: 				awsv1alpha1.AccountCreationFailed,
218: 				initErr.Error(),
219: 				"Failed to initialize new CCS account",
220: 				AccountFailed,
221: 			)
222: 			if stateErr != nil {
223: 				reqLogger.Error(stateErr, "failed setting account state", "desiredState", AccountFailed)
224: 			}
225: 			reqLogger.Error(initErr, "failed initializing new CCS account")
226: 			return result, initErr
227: 		}
228: 		utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, AccountCreating, awsv1alpha1.AccountCreating, AccountCreating)
229: 		updateErr := r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance)
230: 		if updateErr != nil {
231: 			// TODO: Validate this is retryable
232: 			// TODO: Should be re-entrant because account will not have state
233: 			reqLogger.Info("failed updating account state, retrying", "desired state", AccountCreating)
234: 			return reconcile.Result{}, updateErr
235: 		}
236: 
237: 	} else {
238: 		// Normal account creation
239: 
240: 		// Test PendingVerification state creating support case and checking for case status
241: 		if currentAcctInstance.IsPendingVerification() {
242: 			return r.HandleNonCCSPendingVerification(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, awsSetupClient)
243: 		}
244: 
245: 		// Update account Status.Claimed to true if the account is ready and the claim link is not empty
246: 		if currentAcctInstance.IsReadyUnclaimedAndHasClaimLink() {
247: 			return reconcile.Result{}, ClaimAccount(r, currentAcctInstance)
248: 		}
249: 
250: 		// see if in creating for longer than default wait time
251: 		if currentAcctInstance.IsCreating() && utils.CreationConditionOlderThan(*currentAcctInstance, createPendTime) {
252: 			errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Creation pending for longer than %d minutes", utils.WaitTime)
253: 			_, stateErr := r.setAccountFailed(
254: 				reqLogger,
255: 				currentAcctInstance,
256: 				awsv1alpha1.AccountCreationFailed,
257: 				"CreationTimeout",
258: 				errMsg,
259: 				AccountFailed,
260: 			)
261: 			if stateErr != nil {
262: 				reqLogger.Error(stateErr, "failed setting account state", "desiredState", AccountFailed)
263: 				return reconcile.Result{}, stateErr
264: 			}
265: 			return reconcile.Result{}, errors.New(errMsg)
266: 		}
267: 
268: 		if currentAcctInstance.IsUnclaimedAndHasNoState() {
269: 			if !currentAcctInstance.HasAwsAccountID() {
270: 				// before doing anything make sure we are not over the limit if we are just error
271: 				if !totalaccountwatcher.TotalAccountWatcher.AccountsCanBeCreated() {
272: 					// fedramp clusters are all CCS, so the account limit is irrelevant there
273: 					if !config.IsFedramp() {
274: 						reqLogger.Info("AWS Account limit reached. This does not always indicate a problem, it's a limit we enforce in the configmap to prevent runaway account creation")
275: 						// We don't expect the limit to change very frequently, so wait a while before requeueing to avoid hot lopping.
276: 						return reconcile.Result{Requeue: true, RequeueAfter: time.Duration(5) * time.Minute}, nil
277: 					}
278: 				}
279: 
280: 				if err := r.nonCCSAssignAccountID(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, awsSetupClient); err != nil {
281: 					return reconcile.Result{}, err
282: 				}
283: 			} else {
284: 				// set state creating if the account was already created
285: 				utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, "AWS account already created", awsv1alpha1.AccountCreating, AccountCreating)
286: 				err = r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance)
287: 
288: 				if err != nil {
289: 					return reconcile.Result{}, err
290: 				}
291: 			}
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	// Get the owner of the Red Hat amis from the configmap
296: 	amiOwner, ok := configMap.Data["ami-owner"]
297: 	if !ok {
298: 		err = awsv1alpha1.ErrInvalidConfigMap
299: 		return reconcile.Result{}, err
300: 	}
301: 	if err != nil {
302: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "failed getting ami-owner from configmap data")
303: 		return reconcile.Result{}, err
304: 	}
305: 
306: 	// Account init for both BYOC and Non-BYOC
307: 	if currentAcctInstance.ReadyForInitialization() || currentAcctInstance.IsReusedAccountMissingIAMUser() {
308: 		reqLogger.Info("initializing account", "awsAccountID", currentAcctInstance.Spec.AwsAccountID)
309: 
310: 		var creds *sts.AssumeRoleOutput
311: 
312: 		// STS mode doesn't need IAM user init, so just get the creds necessary, init regions, and exit
313: 		if currentAcctInstance.Spec.ManualSTSMode {
314: 			accountClaim, acctClaimErr := r.getAccountClaim(currentAcctInstance)
315: 			if acctClaimErr != nil {
316: 				reqLogger.Error(acctClaimErr, "unable to get accountclaim for sts account")
317: 				utils.SetAccountClaimStatus(
318: 					accountClaim,
319: 					"Failed to get AccountClaim for CSS account",
320: 					"FailedRetrievingAccountClaim",
321: 					awsv1alpha1.ClientError,
322: 					awsv1alpha1.ClaimStatusError,
323: 				)
324: 				err := r.Client.Status().Update(context.TODO(), accountClaim)
325: 				if err != nil {
326: 					reqLogger.Error(err, "failed to update accountclaim status")
327: 				}
328: 				return reconcile.Result{}, acctClaimErr
329: 			}
330: 
331: 			_, creds, err = r.getSTSClient(reqLogger, accountClaim, awsSetupClient)
332: 			if err != nil {
333: 				reqLogger.Error(err, "error getting sts client to initialize regions")
334: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
335: 			}
336: 
337: 		} else {
338: 
339: 			// Set IAMUserIDLabel if not there, and requeue
340: 			if !utils.AccountCRHasIAMUserIDLabel(currentAcctInstance) {
341: 				utils.AddLabels(
342: 					currentAcctInstance,
343: 					utils.GenerateLabel(
344: 						awsv1alpha1.IAMUserIDLabel,
345: 						utils.GenerateShortUID(),
346: 					),
347: 				)
348: 				return reconcile.Result{Requeue: true}, r.Client.Update(context.TODO(), currentAcctInstance)
349: 			}
350: 			var awsAssumedRoleClient awsclient.Client
351: 			awsAssumedRoleClient, creds, err = r.handleCreateAdminAccessRole(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, awsSetupClient)
352: 			if err != nil {
353: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
354: 			}
355: 
356: 			// Use the same ID applied to the account name for IAM usernames
357: 			iamUserUHC := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", iamUserNameUHC, currentAcctInstance.Labels[awsv1alpha1.IAMUserIDLabel])
358: 			secretName, err := r.BuildIAMUser(reqLogger, awsAssumedRoleClient, currentAcctInstance, iamUserUHC, request.Namespace)
359: 			if err != nil {
360: 				reason, errType := getBuildIAMUserErrorReason(err)
361: 				errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Failed to build IAM UHC user %s: %s", iamUserUHC, err)
362: 				_, stateErr := r.setAccountFailed(
363: 					reqLogger,
364: 					currentAcctInstance,
365: 					errType,
366: 					reason,
367: 					errMsg,
368: 					AccountFailed,
369: 				)
370: 				if stateErr != nil {
371: 					reqLogger.Error(err, "failed setting account state", "desiredState", AccountFailed)
372: 				}
373: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
374: 			}
375: 
376: 			currentAcctInstance.Spec.IAMUserSecret = *secretName
377: 			err = r.accountSpecUpdate(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance)
378: 			if err != nil {
379: 				reqLogger.Error(err, "Error updating Secret Ref in Account CR")
380: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
381: 			}
382: 
383: 			reqLogger.Info("IAM User created and saved", "user", iamUserUHC)
384: 
385: 			if currentAcctInstance.IsReusedAccountWithIAMUserSecret() {
386: 				reqLogger.Info("Reused account already initialized, skipping region initialization")
387: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
388: 			}
389: 		}
390: 
391: 		err = r.initializeRegions(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, creds, amiOwner)
392: 
393: 		if isAwsOptInError(err) {
394: 			reqLogger.Info("Aws Account not ready yet, requeuing.")
395: 			return reconcile.Result{
396: 				RequeueAfter: awsAccountInitRequeueDuration,
397: 			}, nil
398: 		}
399: 
400: 		return reconcile.Result{}, err
401: 	}
402: 
403: 	if currentAcctInstance.IsReady() && probeSecretEnabled {
404: 
405: 		roleToAssume := currentAcctInstance.GetAssumeRole()
406: 		awsClient, _, err := stsclient.HandleRoleAssumption(reqLogger, r.awsClientBuilder, currentAcctInstance, r.Client, awsSetupClient, "", roleToAssume, "")
407: 		if err != nil {
408: 			reqLogger.Error(err, "failed building BYOC client from assume_role")
409: 			result, _ := r.handleAWSClientError(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, err)
410: 			// We don't want to error here as erroring will requeue and we will end in an
411: 			// infinite loop.  So we just log the error and exit.
412: 			// TODO maybe there's a better way to handle this?
413: 			return result, nil
414: 		}
415: 
416: 		// Check that secret is valid and reheal it if not
417: 		iamUserUHC := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", iamUserNameUHC, currentAcctInstance.Labels[awsv1alpha1.IAMUserIDLabel])
418: 
419: 		reqLogger.Info("probing account secret")
420: 		err = r.ProbeSecret(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, awsClient, iamUserUHC, request.Namespace)
421: 		if err != nil {
422: 			reqLogger.Error(err, "failed to probe secret")
423: 			return reconcile.Result{}, nil
424: 			// We don't want to error here as erroring will requeue and we will end in an
425: 			// infinite loop.  So we just log the error and exit.
426: 			// TODO maybe there's a better way to handle this?
427: 		}
428: 	}
429: 
430: 	return reconcile.Result{}, nil
431: }
432: 
433: // isAwsOptInError checks weather the error passed in is an instance of an Aws
434: // Error with the error code "OptInRequired". This usually indicates that a
435: // newly created aws account is not yet fully operational.
436: //
437: // returns true only if the error can be cast to an instance of awserr.Error and has the appropriate code set. Passing in `nil` also returns false.
438: func isAwsOptInError(err error) bool {
439: 	if err == nil {
440: 		return false
441: 	}
442: 
443: 	awsError, ok := err.(awserr.Error)
444: 	if !ok {
445: 		return false
446: 	}
447: 
448: 	return awsError.Code() == "OptInRequired"
449: }

451: func (r *AccountReconciler) handleAWSClientError(reqLogger logr.Logger, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account, err error) (reconcile.Result, error) {
452: 	// Get custom failure reason to update account status
453: 	reason := ""
454: 	if aerr, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
455: 		reason = aerr.Code()
456: 	}
457: 	errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Failed to create STS Credentials for account ID %s: %s", currentAcctInstance.Spec.AwsAccountID, err)
458: 	_, stateErr := r.setAccountFailed(
459: 		reqLogger,
460: 		currentAcctInstance,
461: 		awsv1alpha1.AccountClientError,
462: 		reason,
463: 		errMsg,
464: 		AccountFailed,
465: 	)
466: 	if stateErr != nil {
467: 		reqLogger.Error(stateErr, "failed setting account state", "desiredState", AccountFailed)
468: 	}
469: 
470: 	return reconcile.Result{}, err
471: }

473: func (r *AccountReconciler) handleAccountInitializingRegions(reqLogger logr.Logger, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account) (reconcile.Result, error) {
474: 	irCond := currentAcctInstance.GetCondition(awsv1alpha1.AccountInitializingRegions)
475: 	if irCond == nil {
476: 		// This should never happen: the thing that made IsInitializingRegions true
477: 		// also added the Condition.
478: 		errMsg := "Unexpectedly couldn't find the InitializingRegions Condition"
479: 		_, stateErr := r.setAccountFailed(
480: 			reqLogger,
481: 			currentAcctInstance,
482: 			awsv1alpha1.AccountInternalError,
483: 			"MissingCondition",
484: 			errMsg,
485: 			AccountFailed,
486: 		)
487: 		return reconcile.Result{}, stateErr
488: 	}
489: 	// Detect whether we set the InitializingRegions condition in *this* invocation of the
490: 	// operator or a previous one.
491: 	if irCond.LastTransitionTime.Before(utils.GetOperatorStartTime()) {
492: 		// This means the region init goroutine(s) for this account were still running when an
493: 		// earlier invocation of the operator died. We want to recover those, so set them back
494: 		// to Creating, which should cause us to hit the region init code path again.
495: 		// TODO(efried): There's still a small hole here: If the controller was dead for
496: 		// too long, this can still land us in `accountCreatingTooLong` and fail the Account.
497: 		// At the time of this writing, that specifically applies to a) non-CCS accounts, and
498: 		// b) more than 25 minutes between initial Account creation and the Reconcile after
499: 		// this one.
500: 		msg := "Recovering from stale region initialization."
501: 		// We're no longer InitializingRegions
502: 		utils.SetAccountCondition(
503: 			currentAcctInstance.Status.Conditions,
504: 			awsv1alpha1.AccountInitializingRegions,
505: 			// Switch the Condition off
506: 			corev1.ConditionFalse,
507: 			AccountInitializingRegions,
508: 			msg,
509: 			// Make sure the existing condition is updated
510: 			utils.UpdateConditionAlways,
511: 			currentAcctInstance.Spec.BYOC)
512: 		// TODO(efried): This doesn't change the lastTransitionTime, which it really should.
513: 		// In fact, since the Creating condition is guaranteed to already be present, this
514: 		// is currently not doing anything more than
515: 		//    currentAcctInstance.Status.State = AccountCreating
516: 		utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, msg, awsv1alpha1.AccountCreating, AccountCreating)
517: 		// The status update will trigger another Reconcile, but be explicit. The requests get
518: 		// collapsed anyway.
519: 		return reconcile.Result{Requeue: true}, r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance)
520: 	}
521: 	// The goroutines happened in this invocation. Time out if that has taken too long.
522: 	if time.Since(irCond.LastTransitionTime.Time) > regionInitTime {
523: 		errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Initializing regions for longer than %d seconds", regionInitTime/time.Second)
524: 		_, stateErr := r.setAccountFailed(
525: 			reqLogger,
526: 			currentAcctInstance,
527: 			awsv1alpha1.AccountCreationFailed,
528: 			"RegionInitializationTimeout",
529: 			errMsg,
530: 			AccountFailed,
531: 		)
532: 		return reconcile.Result{}, stateErr
533: 	}
534: 	// Otherwise give it a chance to finish.
535: 	reqLogger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Account %s is initializing regions. Ignoring.", currentAcctInstance.Name))
536: 	// No need to requeue. If the goroutine finishes, it changes the state, which will trigger
537: 	// a Reconcile. If it hangs forever, we'll eventually get a freebie periodic Reconcile
538: 	// that will hit the timeout condition above.
539: 	return reconcile.Result{}, nil
540: }

542: func (r *AccountReconciler) HandleNonCCSPendingVerification(reqLogger logr.Logger, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account, awsSetupClient awsclient.Client) (reconcile.Result, error) {
543: 	// If the supportCaseID is blank and Account State = PendingVerification, create a case
544: 	if currentAcctInstance.Spec.BYOC {
545: 		err := errors.New("account is BYOC - should not be handled in NonCCS method")
546: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "a BYOC account passed to non-CCS function", "account", currentAcctInstance.Name)
547: 		return reconcile.Result{}, err
548: 	}
549: 	if !currentAcctInstance.HasSupportCaseID() {
550: 		switch utils.DetectDevMode {
551: 		case utils.DevModeProduction:
552: 			caseID, err := createCase(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, awsSetupClient)
553: 			if err != nil {
554: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
555: 			}
556: 			reqLogger.Info("case created", "CaseID", caseID)
557: 
558: 			// Update supportCaseId in CR
559: 			currentAcctInstance.Status.SupportCaseID = caseID
560: 			utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, "Account pending verification in AWS", awsv1alpha1.AccountPendingVerification, AccountPendingVerification)
561: 			err = SetCurrentAccountServiceQuotas(reqLogger, r.awsClientBuilder, awsSetupClient, currentAcctInstance, r.Client)
562: 			if err != nil {
563: 				reqLogger.Error(err, "failed to set account service quotas")
564: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
565: 			}
566: 
567: 			err = r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance)
568: 			if err != nil {
569: 				reqLogger.Error(err, "failed to update account state, retrying", "desired state", AccountPendingVerification)
570: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
571: 			}
572: 
573: 			// After creating the support case or increasing quotas requeue the request. To avoid flooding
574: 			// and being blacklisted by AWS when starting the operator with a large AccountPool, add a
575: 			// randomInterval (between 0 and 30 secs) to the regular wait time
576: 			randomInterval, err := strconv.Atoi(currentAcctInstance.Spec.AwsAccountID)
577: 			if err != nil {
578: 				reqLogger.Error(err, "failed converting AwsAccountID string to int")
579: 				return reconcile.Result{}, err
580: 			}
581: 			randomInterval %= 30
582: 
583: 			// This will requeue verification for between 30 and 60 (30+30) seconds, depending on the account
584: 			return reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: time.Duration(intervalAfterCaseCreationSecs+randomInterval) * time.Second}, nil
585: 		default:
586: 			log.Info("Running in development mode, Skipping Support Case Creation.")
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 
590: 	var supportCaseResolved bool
591: 	switch utils.DetectDevMode {
592: 	case utils.DevModeProduction:
593: 		resolvedScoped, err := checkCaseResolution(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance.Status.SupportCaseID, awsSetupClient)
594: 		if err != nil {
595: 			reqLogger.Error(err, "Error checking for Case Resolution")
596: 			return reconcile.Result{}, err
597: 		}
598: 		supportCaseResolved = resolvedScoped
599: 	default:
600: 		log.Info("Running in development mode, Skipping case resolution check")
601: 		supportCaseResolved = true
602: 	}
603: 
604: 	if currentAcctInstance.HasOpenQuotaIncreaseRequests() {
605: 		switch utils.DetectDevMode {
606: 		case utils.DevModeProduction:
607: 			return GetServiceQuotaRequest(reqLogger, r.awsClientBuilder, awsSetupClient, currentAcctInstance, r.Client)
608: 		}
609: 	}
610: 
611: 	openCaseCount, _ := currentAcctInstance.GetQuotaRequestsByStatus(awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestInProgress)
612: 	// Case Resolved and quota increases are all done: account is Ready
613: 	if supportCaseResolved && openCaseCount == 0 {
614: 		reqLogger.Info("case and quota increases resolved", "caseID", currentAcctInstance.Status.SupportCaseID)
615: 		utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, "Account ready to be claimed", awsv1alpha1.AccountReady, AccountReady)
616: 		_ = r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance)
617: 		return reconcile.Result{}, nil
618: 	}
619: 
620: 	// Case not Resolved, log info and try again in pre-defined interval
621: 	if !supportCaseResolved {
622: 		reqLogger.Info("case not yet resolved, retrying", "caseID", currentAcctInstance.Status.SupportCaseID, "retry delay", intervalBetweenChecksMinutes)
623: 	}
624: 
625: 	return reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: intervalBetweenChecksMinutes * time.Minute}, nil
626: }

628: // This function takes any service quotas defined in the account CR spec and builds them out in the status. The struct for the service quoats in spec and status will differ
629: // as the spec uses a 'default' region to reduce configuation complexity, whereas the status lists all regions and their service quoata values as it's easier to iterate over.
630: func SetCurrentAccountServiceQuotas(reqLogger logr.Logger, awsClientBuilder awsclient.IBuilder, awsSetupClient awsclient.Client, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account, client client.Client) error {
631: 
632: 	// If standard account, return early
633: 	if currentAcctInstance.Spec.RegionalServiceQuotas == nil {
634: 		return nil
635: 	}
636: 
637: 	var defaultAccountServiceQuotas awsv1alpha1.AccountServiceQuota
638: 	var ok bool
639: 	if defaultAccountServiceQuotas, ok = currentAcctInstance.Spec.RegionalServiceQuotas["default"]; !ok {
640: 		err := fmt.Errorf("could not find default key in RegionalServiceQuotas for Account")
641: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "Could not find default key in RegionalServiceQuotas for Account")
642: 		return err
643: 	}
644: 
645: 	// Need to assume role into the cluster account
646: 	roleToAssume := currentAcctInstance.GetAssumeRole()
647: 	awsAssumedRoleClient, _, err := AssumeRoleAndCreateClient(reqLogger, awsClientBuilder, currentAcctInstance, client, awsSetupClient, "", roleToAssume, "")
648: 	if err != nil {
649: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "Could not impersonate AWS account", "aws-account", currentAcctInstance.Spec.AwsAccountID)
650: 		return err
651: 	}
652: 
653: 	// Get a list of regions enabled in the current account
654: 	regionsEnabledInAccount, err := awsAssumedRoleClient.DescribeRegions(&ec2.DescribeRegionsInput{
655: 		AllRegions: aws.Bool(false),
656: 	})
657: 	if err != nil {
658: 		// Retry on failures related to the slow AWS API
659: 		if aerr, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
660: 			if aerr.Code() == "OptInRequired" {
661: 				return nil
662: 			}
663: 		}
664: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "Failed to retrieve list of regions enabled in this account.")
665: 		return err
666: 	}
667: 
668: 	currentAcctInstance.Status.RegionalServiceQuotas = make(awsv1alpha1.RegionalServiceQuotas)
669: 	// By iterating over the regions returned by AWS as opposed to what's in the Account CR Spec, we
670: 	// won't set the SQ for a region the account doesn't support by mistake.
671: 	for _, region := range regionsEnabledInAccount.Regions {
672: 		// Take the default service quota values and apply to all regions - save to CR status
673: 		currentAcctInstance.Status.RegionalServiceQuotas[*region.RegionName] = defaultAccountServiceQuotas
674: 
675: 		// If we've specified another value for a specific region, set it in the status.
676: 		if currentAcctInstance.Spec.RegionalServiceQuotas[*region.RegionName] != nil {
677: 			// For each value in the spec, set it in the status
678: 			for k, v := range currentAcctInstance.Spec.RegionalServiceQuotas[*region.RegionName] {
679: 				currentAcctInstance.Status.RegionalServiceQuotas[*region.RegionName][k] = v
680: 			}
681: 		}
682: 	}
683: 
684: 	// Blanket setting all status values to TODO.
685: 	for _, quota := range currentAcctInstance.Status.RegionalServiceQuotas {
686: 		for k := range quota {
687: 			quota[k].Status = awsv1alpha1.ServiceRequestTodo
688: 		}
689: 	}
690: 	return nil
691: }

693: func (r *AccountReconciler) finalizeAccount(reqLogger logr.Logger, awsClient awsclient.Client, account *awsv1alpha1.Account) {
694: 	reqLogger.Info("Finalizing Account CR")
695: 	if !account.Spec.ManualSTSMode && utils.AccountCRHasIAMUserIDLabel(account) {
696: 		err := CleanUpIAM(reqLogger, awsClient, account)
697: 		if err != nil {
698: 			reqLogger.Error(err, "Failed to delete IAM user during finalizer cleanup")
699: 		} else {

773: func (r *AccountReconciler) initializeRegions(reqLogger logr.Logger, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account, creds *sts.AssumeRoleOutput, amiOwner string) error {
774: 	awsRegion := config.GetDefaultRegion()
775: 	// Instantiate a client with a default region to retrieve regions we want to initialize
776: 	awsClient, err := r.awsClientBuilder.GetClient(controllerName, r.Client, awsclient.NewAwsClientInput{
777: 		AwsCredsSecretIDKey:     *creds.Credentials.AccessKeyId,
778: 		AwsCredsSecretAccessKey: *creds.Credentials.SecretAccessKey,
779: 		AwsToken:                *creds.Credentials.SessionToken,
780: 		AwsRegion:               awsRegion,
781: 	})
782: 	if err != nil {
783: 		connErr := fmt.Sprintf("unable to connect to default region %s", awsRegion)
784: 		reqLogger.Error(err, connErr)
785: 		return err
786: 	}
787: 
788: 	reqLogger.Info("Created AWS Client for region initialization")
789: 
790: 	// Get a list of regions enabled in the current account
791: 	regionsEnabledInAccount, err := awsClient.DescribeRegions(&ec2.DescribeRegionsInput{
792: 		AllRegions: aws.Bool(false),
793: 	})
794: 	if err != nil {
795: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "Failed to retrieve list of regions enabled in this account.")
796: 		return err
797: 	}
798: 
799: 	reqLogger.Info("Setting account status to Initializing Regions")
800: 	// We're about to kick off region init in a goroutine. This status makes subsequent
801: 	// Reconciles ignore the Account (unless it stays in this state for too long).
802: 	utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, "Initializing Regions", awsv1alpha1.AccountInitializingRegions, AccountInitializingRegions)
803: 	if err := r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance); err != nil {
804: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "Could not update status to Initializing Regions")
805: 		return err
806: 	}
807: 
808: 	reqLogger.Info("Initializing Regions")
809: 
810: 	// For accounts created by the accountpool we want to ensure we initiate all regions
811: 	if !currentAcctInstance.IsBYOC() {
812: 		go r.asyncRegionInit(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, creds, amiOwner, castAWSRegionType(regionsEnabledInAccount.Regions))
813: 		return nil
814: 	}
815: 
816: 	// For non OSD accounts we check the desired region from the accountclaim and ensure that the account has
817: 	// that region enabled, fail otherwise
818: 	accountClaim, acctClaimErr := r.getAccountClaim(currentAcctInstance)
819: 	if acctClaimErr != nil {
820: 		reqLogger.Info("Accountclaim not found")
821: 		return acctClaimErr
822: 	}
823: 	for _, wantedRegion := range accountClaim.Spec.Aws.Regions {
824: 		found := false
825: 		for _, enabledRegion := range regionsEnabledInAccount.Regions {
826: 			if wantedRegion.Name == *enabledRegion.RegionName {
827: 				found = true
828: 			}
829: 		}
830: 		if !found {
831: 			utils.SetAccountStatus(
832: 				currentAcctInstance,
833: 				fmt.Sprintf("AWS region %s is not supported for AWS account %s", wantedRegion, currentAcctInstance.Name),
834: 				awsv1alpha1.AccountInitializingRegions, AccountInitializingRegions)
835: 			if err := r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance); err != nil {
836: 				// statusUpdate logs
837: 				return err
838: 			}
839: 			return err
840: 		}
841: 	}
842: 
843: 	// This initializes supported regions, and updates Account state when that's done. There is
844: 	// no error checking at this level.
845: 	// Only initiate the one requested region
846: 	go r.asyncRegionInit(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, creds, amiOwner, accountClaim.Spec.Aws.Regions)
847: 
848: 	return nil
849: }
850: 
851: // asyncRegionInit initializes supported regions by creating and destroying an instance in each.
852: // Upon completion, it *always* sets the Account status to either Ready or PendingVerification.
853: // There is no mechanism for this func to report errors to its parent. The only error paths
854: // currently possible are:
855: // - The Status update fails.
856: // - This goroutine dies in some horrible and unpredictable way.
857: // In either case we would expect the main reconciler to eventually notice that the Account has
858: // been in the InitializingRegions state for too long, and set it to Failed.
859: func (r *AccountReconciler) asyncRegionInit(reqLogger logr.Logger, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account, creds *sts.AssumeRoleOutput, amiOwner string, regionsEnabledInAccount []awsv1alpha1.AwsRegions) {
860: 
861: 	// Initialize all supported regions by creating and terminating an instance in each
862: 	r.InitializeSupportedRegions(reqLogger, currentAcctInstance, regionsEnabledInAccount, creds, amiOwner)
863: 
864: 	if currentAcctInstance.IsBYOC() {
865: 		utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, "BYOC Account Ready", awsv1alpha1.AccountReady, AccountReady)
866: 
867: 	} else {
868: 		if currentAcctInstance.GetCondition(awsv1alpha1.AccountReady) != nil {
869: 			msg := "Account support case already resolved; Account Ready"
870: 			utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, msg, awsv1alpha1.AccountReady, AccountReady)
871: 			reqLogger.Info(msg)
872: 		} else {
873: 			msg := "Account pending AWS limits verification"
874: 			utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, msg, awsv1alpha1.AccountPendingVerification, AccountPendingVerification)
875: 			reqLogger.Info(msg)
876: 		}
877: 	}
878: 
879: 	if err := r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance); err != nil {
880: 		// If this happens, the Account should eventually get set to Failed by the
881: 		// accountOlderThan check in the main controller.
882: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "asyncRegionInit failed to update status")
883: 	}
884: }

886: // BuildAccount take all parameters required and uses those to make an aws call to CreateAccount. It returns an account ID and and error
887: func (r *AccountReconciler) BuildAccount(reqLogger logr.Logger, awsClient awsclient.Client, account *awsv1alpha1.Account) (string, error) {

891: 	orgOutput, orgErr := CreateAccount(reqLogger, awsClient, account.Name, email)
892: 	// If it was an api or a limit issue don't modify account and exit if anything else set to failed
893: 	if orgErr != nil {
894: 		switch orgErr {
895: 		case awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsFailedCreateAccount:
896: 			utils.SetAccountStatus(account, "Failed to create AWS Account", awsv1alpha1.AccountCreationFailed, AccountFailed)
897: 			err := r.statusUpdate(account)
898: 			if err != nil {
899: 				return "", err
900: 			}
901: 
902: 			reqLogger.Error(awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsFailedCreateAccount, "Failed to create AWS Account")
903: 			return "", orgErr
904: 
905: 		case awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsAccountLimitExceeded:
906: 			log.Error(orgErr, "Failed to create AWS Account limit reached")
907: 			return "", orgErr
908: 
909: 		default:
910: 			log.Error(orgErr, "Failed to create AWS Account nonfatal error")
911: 			return "", orgErr
912: 		}
913: 
914: 	}
915: 
916: 	accountObjectKey := client.ObjectKeyFromObject(account)
917: 	err := r.Client.Get(context.TODO(), accountObjectKey, account)
918: 	if err != nil {
919: 		reqLogger.Error(err, "Unable to get updated Account object after status update")
920: 	}
921: 
922: 	reqLogger.Info("account created successfully")
923: 
924: 	return *orgOutput.CreateAccountStatus.AccountId, nil
925: }

927: // CreateAccount creates an AWS account for the specified accountName and accountEmail in the organization
928: func CreateAccount(reqLogger logr.Logger, client awsclient.Client, accountName, accountEmail string) (*organizations.DescribeCreateAccountStatusOutput, error) {
929: 
930: 	createInput := organizations.CreateAccountInput{
931: 		AccountName: aws.String(accountName),
932: 		Email:       aws.String(accountEmail),
933: 	}
934: 
935: 	createOutput, err := client.CreateAccount(&createInput)
936: 	if err != nil {
937: 		errMsg := "Error creating account"
938: 		var returnErr error
939: 		if aerr, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
940: 			switch aerr.Code() {
941: 			case organizations.ErrCodeConstraintViolationException:
942: 				returnErr = awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsAccountLimitExceeded
943: 			case organizations.ErrCodeServiceException:
944: 				returnErr = awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsInternalFailure
945: 			case organizations.ErrCodeTooManyRequestsException:
946: 				returnErr = awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsTooManyRequests
947: 			case organizations.ErrCodeConcurrentModificationException:
948: 				returnErr = awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsConcurrentModification
949: 			default:
950: 				returnErr = awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsFailedCreateAccount
951: 			}
952: 
953: 		}
954: 		utils.LogAwsError(reqLogger, errMsg, returnErr, err)
955: 		return &organizations.DescribeCreateAccountStatusOutput{}, returnErr
956: 	}
957: 
958: 	describeStatusInput := organizations.DescribeCreateAccountStatusInput{
959: 		CreateAccountRequestId: createOutput.CreateAccountStatus.Id,
960: 	}
961: 
962: 	var accountStatus *organizations.DescribeCreateAccountStatusOutput
963: 	for {
964: 		status, err := client.DescribeCreateAccountStatus(&describeStatusInput)
965: 		if err != nil {
966: 			return &organizations.DescribeCreateAccountStatusOutput{}, err
967: 		}
968: 
969: 		accountStatus = status
970: 		createStatus := *status.CreateAccountStatus.State
971: 
972: 		if createStatus == "FAILED" {
973: 			var returnErr error
974: 			switch *status.CreateAccountStatus.FailureReason {
975: 			case "ACCOUNT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED":
976: 				returnErr = awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsAccountLimitExceeded
977: 			case "INTERNAL_FAILURE":
978: 				returnErr = awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsInternalFailure
979: 			default:
980: 				returnErr = awsv1alpha1.ErrAwsFailedCreateAccount
981: 			}
982: 
983: 			return &organizations.DescribeCreateAccountStatusOutput{}, returnErr
984: 		}
985: 
986: 		if createStatus != "IN_PROGRESS" {
987: 			break
988: 		}
989: 	}
990: 
991: 	return accountStatus, nil
992: }

1196: func (r *AccountReconciler) getCustomTags(log logr.Logger, account *awsv1alpha1.Account) []awsclient.AWSTag {
1197: 	tags := []awsclient.AWSTag{}
1198:

1200: 	if err != nil {

1204: 		}
1205: 		return tags
1206: 	}
1207:

1210: 	}
1211: 
1212: 	return parseTagsFromString(accountClaim.Spec.CustomTags)

1215: // processTagsFromString accepts a set of strings, each being a key=value pair, one per line.  This is typically defined in YAML similar to:
1216: //
1217: // myTags: |
1218: //
1219: //	key=value
1220: //	my-tag=true
1221: //	base64-is-accepted=eWVzIQ==
1222: //
1223: // Specifically, we are splitting on the FIRST "=" to deliniate key=value, so any equals signs after the first will go into the value.
1224: func parseTagsFromString(tags string) []awsclient.AWSTag {
1225: 	parsedTags := []awsclient.AWSTag{}
1226: 
1227: 	// Split on Newline to get key-value pairs
1228: 	kvpairs := strings.Split(tags, "\n")
1229: 
1230: 	for _, tagString := range kvpairs {
1231: 		// Sometimes the last value is an empty string.  Don't process those.
1232: 		if tagString == "" {
1233: 			continue
1234: 		}
1235: 
1236: 		// Use strings.SplitN to only split on the first "="

95: // Retrieve all parents of the given awsId until the predicate returns true.
96: func ParentsTillPredicate(awsId string, client awsclient.Client, p func(s string) bool, parents *[]string) error {
97: 	listParentsInput := organizations.ListParentsInput{
98: 		ChildId: aws.String(awsId),
99: 	}
100: 	listParentsOutput, err := client.ListParents(context.TODO(), &listParentsInput)
101: 	if err != nil {
102: 		return err
103: 	}
104: 	if len(listParentsOutput.Parents) == 0 {
105: 		log.Info("Exhausted search looking for root OU - root OU and account OU likely in separate subtrees.", "path", parents)
106: 		return nil
107: 	} else if len(listParentsOutput.Parents) > 1 {
108: 		log.Info("More than 1 parent returned for an ID - unexpected.", "awsId", awsId)
109: 		return errors.New("More than 1 parents found for Id " + awsId)
110: 	} else {
111: 		id := *listParentsOutput.Parents[0].Id
112: 		*parents = append(*parents, id)
113: 		if p(id) {
114: 			return nil
115: 		}
116: 		return ParentsTillPredicate(id, client, p, parents)
117: 	}
118: }

120: // Verify if the account is already in the root OU
121: // The predicate indicates if the parent considered the desired root was found.
122: func IsAccountInCorrectOU(account awsv1alpha1.Account, client awsclient.Client, isPoolOU func(s string) bool) bool {
123: 	if account.Spec.AwsAccountID == "" {
124: 		return false
125: 	}
126: 	parentList := []string{}
127: 	err := ParentsTillPredicate(account.Spec.AwsAccountID, client, isPoolOU, &parentList)
128: 	if err != nil {
129: 		return false
130: 	}
131: 	if len(parentList) == 1 {
132: 		return true
133: 	}
134: 	return false
135: }

137: func MoveAccount(awsAccountId string, client awsclient.Client, targetOU string, moveAccount bool) error {
138: 	listParentsInput := organizations.ListParentsInput{
139: 		ChildId: aws.String(awsAccountId),
140: 	}
141: 	listParentsOutput, err := client.ListParents(context.TODO(), &listParentsInput)
142: 	if err != nil {
143: 		log.Error(err, "Can not find parent for AWS account", "aws-account", awsAccountId)
144: 		return err
145: 	}
146: 	oldOu := listParentsOutput.Parents[0].Id
147: 	if moveAccount {
148: 		log.Info("Moving aws account from old ou to new ou", "aws-account", awsAccountId, "old-ou", *oldOu, "new-ou", targetOU)
149: 		moveAccountInput := organizations.MoveAccountInput{
150: 			AccountId:           aws.String(awsAccountId),
151: 			DestinationParentId: aws.String(targetOU),
152: 			SourceParentId:      oldOu,
153: 		}
154: 		_, err = client.MoveAccount(context.TODO(), &moveAccountInput)
155: 		if err != nil {
156: 			log.Error(err, "Could not move aws account to new ou", "aws-account", awsAccountId, "ou", targetOU)
157: 			return err
158: 		}
159: 	} else {
160: 		log.Info("Not moving aws account from old ou to new ou (dry run)", "aws-account", awsAccountId, "old-ou", *oldOu, "new-ou", targetOU)
161: 	}
162: 	return nil
163: }

175: // ValidateAccountTags validates the owner tag on an AWS account
176: func ValidateAccountTags(client awsclient.Client, accountId *string, shardName string, accountTagEnabled bool) error {
177: 	listTagsForResourceInput := &organizations.ListTagsForResourceInput{
178: 		ResourceId: accountId,
179: 	}
180: 
181: 	resp, err := client.ListTagsForResource(context.TODO(), listTagsForResourceInput)
182: 	if err != nil {
183: 		return err
184: 	}
185: 
186: 	for _, tag := range resp.Tags {
187: 		if ownerKey == aws.ToString(tag.Key) {
188: 			if shardName != aws.ToString(tag.Value) {
189: 				if accountTagEnabled {
190: 					err := untagAccountOwner(client, aws.ToString(accountId))
191: 					if err != nil {
192: 						log.Error(err, "Unable to remove incorrect owner tag from aws account.", "AWSAccountId", accountId)
193: 						return &AccountValidationError{
194: 							Type: AccountTagFailed,
195: 							Err:  err,
196: 						}
197: 					}
198: 
199: 					complianceTags := make(map[string]string)
200: 					err = account.TagAccount(client, aws.ToString(accountId), shardName, complianceTags)
201: 					if err != nil {
202: 						log.Error(err, "Unable to tag aws account.", "AWSAccountID", accountId)
203: 						return &AccountValidationError{
204: 							Type: AccountTagFailed,
205: 							Err:  err,
206: 						}
207: 					}
208: 
209: 					return nil
210: 				} else {
211: 					log.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Account is not tagged with the correct owner, has %s; want %s", aws.ToString(tag.Value), shardName))
212: 					return nil
213: 				}
214: 			} else {
215: 				return nil
216: 			}
217: 		}
218: 	}
219: 
220: 	if accountTagEnabled {
221: 		complianceTags := make(map[string]string)
222: 		err := account.TagAccount(client, *accountId, shardName, complianceTags)
223: 		if err != nil {
224: 			log.Error(err, "Unable to tag aws account.", "AWSAccountID", accountId)
225: 			return &AccountValidationError{
226: 				Type: AccountTagFailed,
227: 				Err:  err,
228: 			}
229: 		}
230: 		return nil
231: 	} else {
232: 		return &AccountValidationError{
233: 			Type: MissingTag,
234: 			Err:  errors.New("account is not tagged with an owner"),
235: 		}
236: 	}

262: // ValidateComplianceTags validates compliance tags (app-code, service-phase, cost-center) on an AWS account
263: func ValidateComplianceTags(client awsclient.Client, accountId *string, shardName string, accountTagEnabled bool, appCode, servicePhase, costCenter string, complianceTagsEnabled bool) error {
264: 	// Only validate if feature is enabled
265: 	if !complianceTagsEnabled {
266: 		return nil
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	// Fetch existing tags
270: 	listTagsForResourceInput := &organizations.ListTagsForResourceInput{
271: 		ResourceId: accountId,
272: 	}
273: 	resp, err := client.ListTagsForResource(context.TODO(), listTagsForResourceInput)
274: 	if err != nil {
275: 		return err
276: 	}
277: 
278: 	// Build tag map for easy lookup
279: 	existingTags := buildTagMap(resp.Tags)
280: 
281: 	// Check if compliance tags are correct
282: 	if areComplianceTagsInSync(existingTags, appCode, servicePhase, costCenter) {
283: 		// All compliance tags are correct, nothing to do
284: 		return nil
285: 	}
286: 
287: 	// Compliance tags are missing or incorrect
288: 	if !accountTagEnabled {
289: 		// Just log, don't fix
290: 		log.Info("Compliance tags are missing or incorrect but account tagging is disabled", "accountId", *accountId)
291: 		return nil
292: 	}
293: 
294: 	// Re-tag to add/update compliance tags
295: 	complianceTags := make(map[string]string)
296: 	if complianceTagsEnabled {
297: 		if appCode != "" {
298: 			complianceTags["app-code"] = appCode
299: 		}
300: 		if servicePhase != "" {
301: 			complianceTags["service-phase"] = servicePhase
302: 		}
303: 		if costCenter != "" {
304: 			complianceTags["cost-center"] = costCenter
305: 		}
306: 	}
307: 	err = account.TagAccount(client, *accountId, shardName, complianceTags)
308: 	if err != nil {
309: 		log.Error(err, "Unable to update compliance tags on aws account.", "AWSAccountID", accountId)
310: 		return &AccountValidationError{
311: 			Type: AccountTagFailed,
312: 			Err:  err,
313: 		}
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	return nil
317: }

348: func (r *AccountValidationReconciler) ValidateAccountOU(awsClient awsclient.Client, account awsv1alpha1.Account, poolOU string, baseOU string) error {
349: 	// Default OU should be the aao-managed-accounts OU.
350: 	correctOU := poolOU
351: 
352: 	ouNeedsCreating := false
353: 
354: 	// If the legal entity is not empty, it should go into the legalEntity's OU
355: 	if account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID != "" {
356: 		claimedOU, err := r.GetOUIDFromName(awsClient, baseOU, account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID)
357: 		if err != nil {
358: 			if errors.Is(err, awsv1alpha1.ErrNonexistentOU) {
359: 				log.Info("OU doesn't exist. Will need to create it.", "OU Name", account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID)
360: 				ouNeedsCreating = true
361: 			} else {
362: 				log.Info("Unexpected error attempting to get OU ID for Legal Entity", "legal_entity", account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID)
363: 				return &AccountValidationError{
364: 					Type: OULookupFailed,
365: 					Err:  errors.New("unexpected error attempting to get OU ID for legal entity"),
366: 				}
367: 			}
368: 		}
369: 
370: 		correctOU = claimedOU
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	if ouNeedsCreating {
374: 		if accountMoveEnabled {
375: 			createdOU, err := accountclaim.CreateOrFindOU(log, awsClient, account.Spec.LegalEntity.ID, baseOU)
376: 			if err != nil {
377: 				return err
378: 			}
379: 			correctOU = createdOU
380: 		} else {
381: 			log.Info("Would attempt to create the OU here, but AccountMoving is disabled.")
382: 		}
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	if correctOU == "" {
386: 		log.Info("Error attempting to get correct OU. Got empty string.")
387: 		return &AccountValidationError{
388: 			Type: OULookupFailed,
389: 			Err:  fmt.Errorf("empty String when attempting to get correct OU"),
390: 		}
391: 	}
392: 
393: 	inCorrectOU := IsAccountInCorrectOU(account, awsClient, func(s string) bool {
394: 		return s == correctOU
395: 	})
396: 	if inCorrectOU {
397: 		log.Info("Account is already in the correct OU.")
398: 	} else {
399: 		log.Info("Account is not in the correct OU - it will be moved.")
400: 		err := MoveAccount(account.Spec.AwsAccountID, awsClient, correctOU, accountMoveEnabled)
401: 		if err != nil {
402: 			log.Error(err, "Could not move account")
403: 			return &AccountValidationError{
404: 				Type: AccountMoveFailed,
405: 				Err:  err,
406: 			}
407: 		}
408: 	}
409: 	return nil
410: }

412: func (r *AccountValidationReconciler) GetOUIDFromName(client awsclient.Client, parentid string, ouName string) (string, error) {
413: 	// Check in-memory storage first
414: 	if ouID, ok := r.OUNameIDMap[ouName]; ok {
415: 		return ouID, nil
416: 	}
417: 
418: 	// Loop through all OUs in the parent until we find the ID of the OU with the given name
419: 	ouID := ""
420: 	listOrgUnitsForParentID := organizations.ListOrganizationalUnitsForParentInput{
421: 		ParentId: &parentid,
422: 	}
423: 	for ouID == "" {
424: 		// Get a list with a fraction of the OUs in this parent starting from NextToken
425: 		listOut, err := client.ListOrganizationalUnitsForParent(context.TODO(), &listOrgUnitsForParentID)
426: 		if err != nil {
427: 			var aerr smithy.APIError
428: 			if errors.As(err, &aerr) {
429: 				unexpectedErrorMsg := fmt.Sprintf("FindOUFromParentID: Unexpected AWS Error when attempting to find OU ID from Parent: %s", aerr.ErrorCode())
430: 				log.Info(unexpectedErrorMsg)
431: 			}
432: 			return "", err
433: 		}
434: 		for _, element := range listOut.OrganizationalUnits {
435: 			if *element.Name == ouName {
436: 				// We've found the OU, so let's map this to the in-memory store
437: 				r.OUNameIDMap[ouName] = *element.Id
438: 				// and return it
439: 				return *element.Id, nil
440: 			}
441: 		}
442: 		// If the OU is not found we should update the input for the next list call
443: 		if listOut.NextToken != nil {
444: 			listOrgUnitsForParentID.NextToken = listOut.NextToken
445: 			continue
446: 		}
447: 		return "", awsv1alpha1.ErrNonexistentOU
448: 	}
449: 	return ouID, nil
450: }

468: func (r *AccountValidationReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, request ctrl.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {
469: 	log.WithValues("Controller", controllerName, "Request.Namespace", request.Namespace, "Request.Name", request.Name)
470: 	reqLogger := log.WithValues("Controller", controllerName, "Request.Namespace", request.Namespace, "Request.Name", request.Name)
471: 
472: 	// Setup: retrieve account and awsClient
473: 	var account awsv1alpha1.Account
474: 	err := r.Client.Get(context.TODO(), request.NamespacedName, &account)
475: 	if err != nil {
476: 		log.Info("Account does not exist", "account-request", request.NamespacedName, "error", err)
477: 		return utils.DoNotRequeue()
478: 	}
479: 	if account.DeletionTimestamp != nil {
480: 		log.Info("Account is being deleted - not running any validations", "account", account.Name)
481: 		return utils.DoNotRequeue()
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	// Check if reconciliation is paused for this account
485: 	if account.Annotations[PauseReconciliationAnnotation] == "true" {
486: 		log.Info("Reconciliation paused for account - skipping all validations", "account", account.Name)
487: 		return utils.DoNotRequeue()
488: 	}
489: 
490: 	cm, err := utils.GetOperatorConfigMap(r.Client)
491: 	if err != nil {
492: 		log.Error(err, "Could not retrieve the operator configmap")
493: 		return utils.RequeueAfter(5 * time.Minute)
494: 	}
495: 
496: 	isOptInRegionFeatureEnabled, err := utils.GetFeatureFlagValue(cm, "feature.opt_in_regions")
497: 	if err != nil {
498: 		reqLogger.Info("Could not retrieve feature flag 'feature.opt_in_regions' - region Opt-In is disabled")
499: 		isOptInRegionFeatureEnabled = false
500: 	}
501: 	reqLogger.Info("Is feature.opt_in_regions enabled?", "enabled", isOptInRegionFeatureEnabled)
502: 
503: 	enabled, err := strconv.ParseBool(cm.Data["feature.validation_move_account"])
504: 	if err != nil {
505: 		log.Info("Could not retrieve feature flag 'feature.validation_move_account' - account moving is disabled")
506: 	} else {
507: 		accountMoveEnabled = enabled
508: 	}
509: 	log.Info("Is moving accounts enabled?", "enabled", accountMoveEnabled)
510: 
511: 	enabled, err = strconv.ParseBool(cm.Data["feature.validation_tag_account"])
512: 	if err != nil {
513: 		log.Info("Could not retrieve feature flag 'feature.validation_tag_account' - account tagging is disabled")
514: 	} else {
515: 		accountTagEnabled = enabled
516: 	}
517: 	log.Info("Is tagging accounts enabled?", "enabled", accountTagEnabled)
518: 
519: 	enabled, err = strconv.ParseBool(cm.Data["feature.compliance_tags"])
520: 	if err != nil {
521: 		log.Info("Could not retrieve feature flag 'feature.compliance_tags' - compliance tagging is disabled")
522: 	} else {
523: 		complianceTagsEnabled = enabled
524: 	}
525: 	log.Info("Is compliance tagging enabled?", "enabled", complianceTagsEnabled)
526: 
527: 	enabled, err = strconv.ParseBool(cm.Data["feature.validation_delete_account"])
528: 	if err != nil {
529: 		log.Info("Could not retrieve feature flag 'feature.validation_delete_account' - account deletion is disabled")
530: 	} else {
531: 		accountDeletionEnabled = enabled
532: 	}
533: 	log.Info("Is deleting accounts enabled?", "enabled", accountDeletionEnabled)
534: 
535: 	awsClientInput := awsclient.NewAwsClientInput{
536: 		AwsRegion:  config.GetDefaultRegion(),
537: 		SecretName: utils.AwsSecretName,
538: 		NameSpace:  awsv1alpha1.AccountCrNamespace,
539: 	}
540: 	awsClient, err := r.awsClientBuilder.GetClient(controllerName, r.Client, awsClientInput)
541: 	if err != nil {
542: 		log.Error(err, "Could not retrieve AWS client.")
543: 	}
544: 
545: 	// Here the actual checks start:
546: 
547: 	if err := ValidateRemoval(account); err == nil {
548: 		if accountDeletionEnabled {
549: 			log.Info("Cleaning up account that is failed & has no AWS account", "account", account)
550: 			err := r.Client.Delete(ctx, &account)
551: 			if err != nil {
552: 				log.Error(err, "failed to delete account", "account", account.Name)
553: 				return utils.RequeueWithError(err)
554: 			}
555: 		} else {
556: 			log.Info("Not cleaning up account that is failed & has no AWS account (dry run)", "account", account.Name)
557: 		}
558: 	}
559: 
560: 	err = ValidateAccountOrigin(account)
561: 	if err != nil {
562: 		// Decide who we will requeue now
563: 		validationError, ok := err.(*AccountValidationError)
564: 		if ok && validationError.Type == InvalidAccount {
565: 			return utils.DoNotRequeue()
566: 		}
567: 		return utils.RequeueWithError(err)
568: 	}
569: 
570: 	err = ValidateAwsAccountId(account)
571: 	if err != nil {

507: // BuildAndDestroyEC2Instances runs an ec2 instance and terminates it
508: func (r *AccountReconciler) BuildAndDestroyEC2Instances(
509: 	reqLogger logr.Logger,
510: 	account *awsv1alpha1.Account,
511: 	awsClient awsclient.Client,
512: 	instanceInfo awsv1alpha1.AmiSpec,
513: 	managedTags []awsclient.AWSTag,
514: 	customerTags []awsclient.AWSTag,
515: 	kmsKeyId string) error {
516: 	instanceID, err := CreateEC2Instance(reqLogger, account, awsClient, instanceInfo, managedTags, customerTags, kmsKeyId)
517: 	if err != nil {
518: 		// Terminate instance id if it exists
519: 		if instanceID != "" {
520: 			// Log instance id of instance that will be terminated
521: 			reqLogger.Error(err, fmt.Sprintf("Early termination of instance with ID: %s", instanceID))
522: 			termErr := TerminateEC2Instance(reqLogger, awsClient, instanceID)
523: 			if termErr != nil {
524: 				controllerutils.LogAwsError(reqLogger, "AWS error while attempting to terminate instance", nil, termErr)
525: 			}
526: 		}
527: 		return err
528: 	}
529: 
530: 	// Wait till instance is running
531: 	var DescError error
532: 	totalWait := controllerutils.WaitTime * 60
533: 	currentWait := 1
534: 	// Double the wait time until we reach totalWait seconds
535: 	for totalWait > 0 {
536: 		currentWait = currentWait * 2
537: 		if currentWait > totalWait {
538: 			currentWait = totalWait
539: 		}
540: 		totalWait -= currentWait
541: 		time.Sleep(time.Duration(currentWait) * time.Second)
542: 		var code int
543: 		code, DescError = DescribeEC2Instances(reqLogger, awsClient, instanceID)
544: 		if code == 16 { // 16 represents a successful region initialization
545: 			reqLogger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("EC2 Instance: %s Running", instanceID))
546: 			break
547: 		} else if code == 401 { // 401 represents an UnauthorizedOperation error
548: 			// Missing permission to perform operations, account needs to fail
549: 			reqLogger.Error(DescError, fmt.Sprintf("Missing required permissions for account %s", account.Name))
550: 			return err
551: 		}
552: 
553: 	}
554: 
555: 	if DescError != nil {
556: 		// Log an error and make sure that instance is terminated
557: 		DescErrorMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Could not get EC2 instance state, terminating instance %s", instanceID)
558: 
559: 		if DescError, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
560: 			DescErrorMsg = fmt.Sprintf("Could not get EC2 instance state: %s, terminating instance %s", DescError.Code(), instanceID)
561: 		}
562: 
563: 		reqLogger.Error(DescError, DescErrorMsg)
564: 	}
565: 
566: 	// Terminate Instance
567: 	reqLogger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Terminating EC2 Instance: %s", instanceID))
568: 
569: 	err = TerminateEC2Instance(reqLogger, awsClient, instanceID)
570: 	if err != nil {
571: 		return err
572: 	}
573: 
574: 	reqLogger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("EC2 Instance: %s Terminated", instanceID))
575: 
576: 	return nil
577: }

579: // CreateEC2Instance creates ec2 instance and returns its instance ID
580: func CreateEC2Instance(reqLogger logr.Logger, account *awsv1alpha1.Account, client awsclient.Client, instanceInfo awsv1alpha1.AmiSpec, managedTags []awsclient.AWSTag, customerTags []awsclient.AWSTag, customerKmsKeyId string) (string, error) {
581: 
582: 	// Retain instance id
583: 	var timeoutInstanceID string
584: 
585: 	// Loop until an EC2 instance is created or timeout.
586: 	totalWait := controllerutils.WaitTime * 60
587: 	currentWait := 1
588: 	for totalWait > 0 {
589: 		currentWait = currentWait * 2
590: 		if currentWait > totalWait {
591: 			currentWait = totalWait
592: 		}
593: 		totalWait -= currentWait
594: 		time.Sleep(time.Duration(currentWait) * time.Second)
595: 		tags := awsclient.AWSTags.BuildTags(account, managedTags, customerTags).GetEC2Tags()
596: 
597: 		ebsBlockDeviceSetup := &ec2.EbsBlockDevice{
598: 			VolumeSize:          aws.Int64(10),
599: 			DeleteOnTermination: aws.Bool(true),
600: 			Encrypted:           aws.Bool(true),
601: 		}
602: 		if customerKmsKeyId != "" {
603: 			ebsBlockDeviceSetup.KmsKeyId = aws.String(customerKmsKeyId)
604: 		}
605: 		// Specify the details of the instance that you want to create.
606: 		input := &ec2.RunInstancesInput{
607: 			ImageId:      aws.String(instanceInfo.Ami),
608: 			InstanceType: aws.String(instanceInfo.InstanceType),
609: 			MinCount:     aws.Int64(1),
610: 			MaxCount:     aws.Int64(1),
611: 			TagSpecifications: []*ec2.TagSpecification{
612: 				{
613: 					ResourceType: &awsv1alpha1.InstanceResourceType,
614: 					Tags:         tags,
615: 				},
616: 				{
617: 					ResourceType: &awsv1alpha1.VolumeResourceType,
618: 					Tags:         tags,
619: 				},
620: 			},
621: 			// We specify block devices mainly to enable EBS encryption
622: 			BlockDeviceMappings: []*ec2.BlockDeviceMapping{
623: 				{
624: 					DeviceName: aws.String("/dev/sda1"),
625: 					Ebs:        ebsBlockDeviceSetup,
626: 				},
627: 			},
628: 		}
629: 
630: 		// If fedramp, create subnet and set value for RunInstancesInput
631: 		if config.IsFedramp() {
632: 			subnetID, err := createSubnet(reqLogger, client, account, managedTags, customerTags, sampleCIDR, sampleVPCID)
633: 			if err != nil {
634: 				subnetErr := fmt.Sprintf("Error while trying to create subnet: %s", subnetID)
635: 				controllerutils.LogAwsError(reqLogger, subnetErr, nil, err)
636: 			}
637: 			input.SubnetId = aws.String(subnetID)
638: 		}
639: 		runResult, runErr := client.RunInstances(input)
640: 
641: 		// Return on unexpected errors:
642: 		if runErr != nil {
643: 			if aerr, ok := runErr.(awserr.Error); ok {
644: 				// We want to ensure that we don't leave any instances around when there is an error
645: 				// possible that there is no instance here
646: 				if len(runResult.Instances) > 0 {
647: 					timeoutInstanceID = *runResult.Instances[0].InstanceId
648: 				}
649: 				switch aerr.Code() {
650: 				case "PendingVerification", "OptInRequired":
651: 					continue
652: 				default:
653: 					controllerutils.LogAwsError(reqLogger, "Failed while trying to create EC2 instance", runErr, runErr)
654: 					return timeoutInstanceID, runErr
655: 				}
656: 			}
657: 			return timeoutInstanceID, awsv1alpha1.ErrFailedAWSTypecast
658: 		}
659: 
660: 		// No error was found, instance is running, return instance id
661: 		return *runResult.Instances[0].InstanceId, nil
662: 	}
663: 
664: 	// Timeout occurred, return instance id and timeout error
665: 	return timeoutInstanceID, awsv1alpha1.ErrCreateEC2Instance
666: }

668: // DescribeEC2Instances returns the InstanceState code
669: func DescribeEC2Instances(reqLogger logr.Logger, client awsclient.Client, instanceID string) (int, error) {
670: 	// States and codes
671: 	// 0 : pending
672: 	// 16 : running
673: 	// 32 : shutting-down
674: 	// 48 : terminated
675: 	// 64 : stopping
676: 	// 80 : stopped
677: 	// 401 : failed
678: 
679: 	result, err := client.DescribeInstanceStatus(&ec2.DescribeInstanceStatusInput{
680: 		InstanceIds: aws.StringSlice([]string{instanceID}),
681: 	})
682: 
683: 	if err != nil {
684: 		controllerutils.LogAwsError(reqLogger, "New AWS Error while describing EC2 instance", nil, err)
685: 		if aerr, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
686: 			if aerr.Code() == "UnauthorizedOperation" {
687: 				return 401, err
688: 			}
689: 		}
690: 		return 0, err
691: 	}
692: 
693: 	if len(result.InstanceStatuses) > 1 {
694: 		return 0, errors.New("more than one EC2 instance found")
695: 	}
696: 
697: 	if len(result.InstanceStatuses) == 0 {
698: 		return 0, errors.New("no EC2 instances found")
699: 	}
700: 	return int(*result.InstanceStatuses[0].InstanceState.Code), nil
701: }

728: // cleanRegion will remove all hanging account creation t2.micro instances running in the current region
729: func cleanRegion(client awsclient.Client, logger logr.Logger, accountName string, region string) (bool, error) {
730: 	cleaned := false
731: 	// Make a dry run to certify we have required authentication
732: 	_, err := client.DescribeInstances(&ec2.DescribeInstancesInput{
733: 		DryRun: aws.Bool(true),
734: 	})
735: 	// If we receive an AuthFailure alert we do not attempt to clean this region
736: 	if aerr, ok := err.(awserr.Error); ok {
737: 		if aerr.Code() == "AuthFailure" {
738: 			logger.Error(err, fmt.Sprintf("We do not have the correct authentication to clean or initialize region: %s backing out gracefully", region))
739: 			return cleaned, err
740: 		}
741: 	}
742: 	// Get the instance type that will be used for this region and filter by that one.
743: 	instanceType, err := RetrieveAvailableMicroInstanceType(logger, client)
744: 	if err != nil {
745: 		return cleaned, err
746: 	}
747: 	// Get a list of all running t2.micro instances
748: 	output, err := client.DescribeInstances(&ec2.DescribeInstancesInput{
749: 		MaxResults: aws.Int64(100),
750: 		Filters: []*ec2.Filter{
751: 			{
752: 				Name: aws.String("instance-type"),
753: 				Values: []*string{
754: 					aws.String(instanceType),
755: 				},
756: 			},
757: 			{
758: 				Name: aws.String("instance-state-name"),
759: 				Values: []*string{
760: 					aws.String("running"),
761: 				},
762: 			},
763: 			{
764: 				Name: aws.String("tag-key"),
765: 				Values: []*string{
766: 					aws.String(awsv1alpha1.ClusterAccountNameTagKey),
767: 				},
768: 			},
769: 			{
770: 				Name: aws.String("tag-key"),
771: 				Values: []*string{
772: 					aws.String(awsv1alpha1.ClusterNamespaceTagKey),
773: 				},
774: 			},
775: 			{
776: 				Name: aws.String("tag-key"),
777: 				Values: []*string{
778: 					aws.String(awsv1alpha1.ClusterClaimLinkTagKey),
779: 				},
780: 			},
781: 			{
782: 				Name: aws.String("tag-key"),
783: 				Values: []*string{
784: 					aws.String(awsv1alpha1.ClusterClaimLinkNamespaceTagKey),
785: 				},
786: 			},
787: 		},
788: 	})
789: 	if err != nil {
790: 		logger.Error(err, "Error while describing instances")
791: 		return cleaned, err
792: 	}
793: 	// Remove any hanging instances
794: 
795: 	for _, reservation := range output.Reservations {
796: 		for _, instance := range reservation.Instances {
797: 			cleaned = true
798: 			logger.Info("Terminating hanging instance", "instance", instance.InstanceId, "account", accountName)
799: 			err = TerminateEC2Instance(logger, client, *instance.InstanceId)
800: 			if err != nil {
801: 				logger.Error(err, "Error while attempting to terminate instance", "instance", *instance.InstanceId)
802: 				return false, err
803: 			}
804: 		}
805: 	}
806: 	return cleaned, nil
807: }

810: func RetrieveAvailableMicroInstanceType(logger logr.Logger, awsClient awsclient.Client) (string, error) {
811: 	// FIXME: For unknown reasons attempting to use the free-tier-eligible
812: 	// filter from go returns *nothing*, but works fine from the CLI.
